inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL scalar query constructs a calendar date from a year and ordinal day number with MAKEDATE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to one out-of-range ordinal that rolls into the following year, isolating MAKEDATE evaluation and date metadata.

fixture_notes: The single 2023 day-366 input must produce 2024-01-01 in MariaDB.
determinism_notes: The fixture has one fixed row and one ordered select with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE calendar_ordinals (calendar_year INT NOT NULL, ordinal_day INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT MAKEDATE(calendar_year, ordinal_day) AS constructed_date FROM calendar_ordinals
